resources.string: One warning per published radar ahead, with the voice. Pops up, also on Android Auto.
Silent notice Android requires while the app follows your position on a drive. No need to look at it.
At most one notice a day when something stops the radar warnings.
Radares Anunciados is watching the published radars
Self-test running: you will hear a test warning.
Every radar keeps the source and attribution the file publishes.
Uses Google Play location and activity recognition services. No account, no analytics, no server of its own.

Warns from published positions only. Spain\'s Reglamento General de Circulación (art. 18.3) bans detectors and jammers and leaves out «los mecanismos de aviso que informan de la posición de los sistemas de vigilancia del tráfico». This app does not detect, receive or interfere with any radar signal.
The app knows by itself when you are driving and warns you by voice and with a notification before every published radar. Nothing to touch to drive.
Your precise position is needed to measure the distance to each radar. It never leaves the phone.
To warn with the phone in your pocket, Android asks you to choose \"%1$s\" in the app\'s location settings.
Every warning also shows as a pop-up notification, on the phone and on Android Auto.
With this permission Android tells the app when you get into a car, and the first warning comes sooner.
